title.en: Tale 18 — The Crow Among the Owls

sentences.en: The king of the owls said: who are you?

sentences.ar: ومين عمل فيك هيك؟
sentences.en: And who did this to you?

sentences.en: I told him: the owls are stronger than us; we must ask for peace and give them the tree.

sentences.ar: فقال إني خاين، ونتف ريشي، ورماني.
sentences.en: So he said I was a traitor, plucked my feathers, and threw me out.

sentences.en: A crow is a crow, even if he speaks sweetly.

sentences.ar: العدو اللي بتاخده لبيتك أخطر من اللي برا.
sentences.en: The enemy you take into your house is more dangerous than the one outside.

sentences.ar: بس ملك البوم شاف الجروح وقال: هاد مسكين، وبيعرف أسرارهم.
sentences.en: But the king of the owls saw the wounds and said: this poor thing knows their secrets.

sentences.en: And one day, when he could fly again, he went to the king of the owls.

sentences.en: He said to him: I want to go out and bring firewood, so you can keep warm in the winter.

sentences.ar: وبيوم، بالنهار، والبوم نايمين جوا، طار الغراب على الشجرة.
sentences.en: And one day, by daylight, with the owls asleep inside, the crow flew to the tree.

sentences.ar: قال للغربان: جيبوا نار.
sentences.en: He said to the crows: bring fire.

sentences.en: Every crow carried an ember from the shepherds' fires, and they flew to the cave.

sentences.en: And the owls inside could not get out.

sentences.ar: لأنه الباب كان نار، والنهار أعمى.
sentences.en: Because the doorway was fire, and the day was blind.

sentences.ar: وهيك خلصت العداوة القديمة.
sentences.en: And so the old enmity ended.
